question: The 42ⁿd Amendment of the Constitution of India was passed in the year ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1976**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The 42nd Amendment of the Constitution of India: **

 
 
• The 42nd Amendment of the Constitution of India was **enacted **in the year 1976.
 
• It is officially known as the** Constitution Act, 1976.**
 
• It was enacted during the Emergency by the Indian National Congress Head Indira Gandhi.
 
• It is considered the **most controversial Constitutional Amendment** in Indian history.
 
• It is often called a **"mini-Constitution"** or the **"Constitution of Indira".**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Some Important Provisions of the 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1976

 
 
• Added three new words** socialists, secular, and integrity** in the Preamble.
 
• Added Fundamental Duties by the citizens** (new part IV A).**
 
• Made the President bound by the advice of the cabinet.
 
• Provided administrative tribunals and tribunals for other matters (Added Part XIV A).
 
• Added three new DPSPs i.e. equal justice and free legal aid, participation of workers in the management of industries, and protection of the environment, forest, and wildlife.
